text: dsh-windows-notify 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 Windows 通知插件：主 agent 每完成一轮，就通过 PowerShell 5.1 和 WinRT 显示 toast。它监听回合结束事件，并在 DSH 设置页提供通知开关、提示音、回答摘要、标题前缀和子代理通知选项，也可发送测试通知。通知按会话和回合去重，默认忽略子代理会话。适合希望及时看到 DSH 回合完成提示的 Windows 用户。需要 Windows 和 PowerShell 5.1；不需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-windows-notify shows a Windows toast when a DSH agent turn ends. It uses PowerShell 5.1 and WinRT. DSH Settings let users control sound, answer text, title prefix, and subagent alerts. Notifications are deduplicated by session and turn. Requires Windows; no API key is needed.
想在 Windows 上让 DSH 每完成一轮就弹出桌面通知。
DSH 能不能把回答摘要放进系统通知里，方便我暂时离开电脑时查看？
Can I get a Windows toast when a DSH agent turn finishes?
dsh-windows-notify 的功能「回合完成通知」：主 agent 每完成一轮就显示 Windows 原生 toast，可带上截断后的回答摘要和提示音。通知在 DSH 设置页调整，也可点发送测试通知检查效果。
dsh-windows-notify 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 23 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-windows-notify README · 特性：- **每回合一条**。去重键是 `<sessionId>#<turn>`，同一个会话的第 2、3 回合都会弹（0.1.0 的 bug 见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)）。
- **开关在设置页**。注册 `settings.section`（order 16），位于「插件」与「智能体预设」之间，改完立即生效，不用重启。
- **默认不吵**。子代理会话的回合默认不弹（`notifySubagents: false`）。
- **零依赖**。无构建步骤、无 npm 依赖、无 native 模块：宿主侧是一个 ESM 文件 + 一个 PowerShell 5.1 脚本，客户端侧是一个浏览器 ESM 文件。
- **可诊断**。每回合一行日志（弹了 / 跳过 + 原因 + 真实 turn 号）。
- **插件页中英双语**。`locale/en.json` + `locale/zh.json` 提供插件标题与描述，界面语言切到英文就显示英文；自带 `icon.svg`。
dsh-windows-notify README · 安装：**要求**：Windows 10 / 11（需要 `Windows.UI.Notifications` WinRT API）+ DSH `>= 0.1.7-rc.1`。

dsh-windows-notify README · 让 agent 帮你装（最省事）：在 DSH 里新开一个会话，直接说：

> 帮我安装 https://github.com/528085390/dsh-windows-notify 这个插件

它会把这个地址写进 profile 的 `dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles`，跑 `pnpm install`，
然后提醒你重启 DSH。装了 DSH CLI 的环境里，等价于：

```powershell
dsh plugin add https://github.com/528085390/dsh-windows-notify
```

dsh-windows-notify README · 为什么不能用包名安装：`dsh plugin add <spec>` 里，**纯包名走 npm registry**。本仓库没有发布到 npm，而 registry 上
`dsh-windows-notify` 这个名字属于**另一位作者**（Yxkzx，当前 `1.0.2`）——它同样是一个 DSH 通知插件、
同样声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，所以装裸包名**不会报错**，只会静默装上别人的代码；两边包名还相同，
会和本仓库的依赖记录撞在一起。

包名 ≠ 仓库名。要用包名安装，得先 `npm publish`；或者发布到自己的 scope（例如
`@528085390/dsh-windows-notify`），那要同时改 `package.json` 的 `name` 和 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `name:`。

dsh-windows-notify README · dsh-windows-notify：A **native Windows notification** plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): one WinRT toast every
time an agent turn finishes, with every switch living in DSH Settings instead of a config file.

dsh-windows-notify README · dsh-windows-notify：

[中文](README.md) | **English**

dsh-windows-notify README · Features：- **One toast per turn.** Deduplicated by `<sessionId>#<turn>`, so turns 2 and 3 of the same session fire too (see the 0.1.0 bug in [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)).
- **Switches in Settings.** A `settings.section` contribution (order 16) sitting between *Plugins* and *Agent presets*; changes apply immediately, no restart.
- **Quiet by default.** Turns from subagent sessions are muted (`notifySubagents: false`).
- **Zero dependencies.** No build step, no npm packages, no native modules: one ESM file plus a PowerShell 5.1 script on the host side, one browser ESM file on the client side.
- **Debuggable.** One log line per turn (fired / skipped, the reason, and the real turn number).
- **Bilingual plugin page.** `locale/en.json` and `locale/zh.json` supply the plugin title and description, and `icon.svg` supplies its icon.
dsh-windows-notify README · Installation：**Requirements**: Windows 10 / 11 (needs the `Windows.UI.Notifications` WinRT API) and DSH `>= 0.1.7-rc.1`.

dsh-windows-notify README · Let an agent install it：Open a new DSH session and just say:

> Install the plugin at https://github.com/528085390/dsh-windows-notify

It writes that address into the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`, runs `pnpm install`,
and asks you to restart DSH. With the DSH CLI available this is the same as:

```powershell
dsh plugin add https://github.com/528085390/dsh-windows-notify
```

dsh-windows-notify README · GUI / CLI：Sidebar **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, then paste any of these — they all point at this repository:

```
https://github.com/528085390/dsh-windows-notify
git+https://github.com/528085390/dsh-windows-notify.git
github:528085390/dsh-windows-notify
```

Command line: `dsh plugin add <any of the above>`.

dsh-windows-notify README · GUI / CLI：After installing, turn `dsh-windows-notify` on in the **Plugins** page and **restart DSH** — the host half is
imported at startup and has no hot reload. To pin a revision, append `#<commit>`:
`https://github.com/528085390/dsh-windows-notify#<sha>`.

dsh-windows-notify README · Why not the bare package name：In `dsh plugin add <spec>` a **bare name resolves through the npm registry**. This repository is not published
there, and the name `dsh-windows-notify` on npm belongs to **another author** (Yxkzx, currently `1.0.2`) — also a
DSH notification plugin, also declaring `dsh.bundle.patch`. Installing the bare name therefore **does not fail**:
it silently installs someone else's code, and the identical package name collides with this repository's dependency.
section: Why not the bare package name

text:
dsh-windows-notify README · Why not the bare package name：A package name is not a repository name. Installing by name would require publishing to npm — or publishing under
your own scope (e.g. `@528085390/dsh-windows-notify`), which also means renaming `package.json`'s `name` and
`name:` in `cordis.patch.yml`.
section: Why not the bare package name

dsh-windows-notify README · Settings page (recommended)：| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Enable notifications | on | Master switch; off means even the test toast is suppressed |
| Sound | on | Whether the toast plays a sound |
| Include message text | on | Off replaces the body with a fixed “turn finished” line |
| Body length | 80 | Maximum characters taken from the message (20–300) |
| Title prefix | `DeepSeek Harness` | Title format is `<prefix> · <session title>` |
| Notify for subagents | off | Also toast turns from subagent sessions |
| Send test notification | — | Fires one toast right away to verify the chain |

dsh-windows-notify README · Command line fallback：If the GUI is unavailable, the plugin directory ships `toggle.cmd` (flip the switch) and `status.cmd`
(current values plus the tail of the log). `toggle.ps1` only touches `enabled` and never clobbers the
other options set from the settings page.

dsh-windows-notify README · Configuration：Precedence: **state file > the cordis row's `config` > built-in defaults**, read on every turn, so edits apply immediately.

State file `~/.dsh/windows-notify.json`:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "sound": true,
  "includeText": true,

Field types and bounds: [docs/bridge-protocol.md](docs/bridge-protocol.md#状态文件) (Chinese).

dsh-windows-notify README · How it works：- The host half hooks `agent/turn-stopping` and raises the toast through `powershell.exe` (5.1) and the WinRT
  `ToastNotificationManager`; the AUMID reuses the shortcut Windows already registered for PowerShell, so no
  custom shortcut is needed.
- The settings page reads and writes options through a **same-origin HTTP bridge** (`/api/dsh-windows-notify/*`)
  rather than a schemastery Config — see [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md#为什么不用-schemastery-config) (Chinese).
- The client half is discovered through `package.json`'s `dsh.client` plus `exports["./client"]`; there is **no build step**.
